integrity: Self-contained analytic proof in RESULT.md, independently implemented arithmetic and finite examples in CHECK.py. Numerical checking is supplementary and does not constitute proof for all parameters.
scientific_limitations: All integer q >= 3, unequal positive exponential decay rates and lattice Z x (1/q)Z only. The q=2 and equal-rate cases are not claims of novelty. No optimal arbitrary-lattice geometry, arbitrary rational density or noise stability. A plausible 1996 source was abstract-only due to access limitations; independent mathematical review remains outstanding.
title: Sharp asymmetric double-exponential Gabor frame bounds at every higher integer redundancy
